02 / ABOUT
About Foyt Labs.
Foyt Labs is the project directory of wfo. The collection includes a native Ollama client, keyboard configuration software, and Omarchy shell plugins.
Each project links to its public GitHub repository, where you can find source code, installation instructions, and issue tracking.
